Capcom vs SNK - Millennium Fight 2001.name: Capcom vs. SNK: Millennium Fight 2001
Capcom vs SNK - Millennium Fight 2001.summary: Capcom vs SNK: Millennium Fight 2001 is an unlicensed port of Capcom vs. SNK: Millennium Fight 2000. Presumably based on the work done on the Game Boy Color port of Street Heroes, there are possibilities that Ei-How Yang was the main programmer of this game as well, despite unproven and incorrect assumptions of Makon Soft being involved.
